reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 13.1 extends the subscription grant to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf; 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology including Affiliates and contractor support.

13.3 satisfies the remaining preferred elements — transfer to an Affiliate or successor and revocation/suspension limited to a material uncured breach after notice and cure — so the licence is not revocable at Vendor's discretion.

No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; deterministic checks (affiliate coverage, no at-will revocation) both pass and 14.3 reinforces the perpetual licence over Vendor Technology needed to use Deliverables.
